profile.name: Kenneth Winsor
profile.headline: Business Administration Student at Loyola Marymount University | Events, Operations & Guest Experience
profile.summary: Business Administration student at Loyola Marymount University with hands-on experience behind the scenes of university special events. As personal assistant to LMU's Special Events Coordinator, I supported event planning, day-of operations, and guest services. I bring strong organization, administrative skills, and fluent Spanish to teams that value reliable execution and a great guest experience.

experience.title: Event Staff — Assistant to the Special Events Coordinator
experience.summary: Served as personal assistant to the Special Events Coordinator at Loyola Marymount University in Los Angeles, supporting the planning and day-of execution of campus events, coordinating administrative tasks, and assisting guests.

education.summary: Undergraduate studies in LMU's College of Business Administration, Los Angeles, CA.

projects.name: kenwinsor.xyz — this resume site
projects.summary: A work-in-progress personal site built for my cloud course. A FastAPI app reads this resume from PostgreSQL on every request. I first deployed it on an Azure Linux VM behind Nginx, then migrated it to Railway, with my own domain on Cloudflare DNS, email through Zoho Mail, and Google Analytics.
